options.content:
## Traffic Status — live ops wall
**Every panel is real-time** (VictoriaMetrics `voip-metrics-vm` — Kamailio + FreeSWITCH `mod_prometheus`, scraped ~15s), so this reflects the fleet as it is **right now**, not the retrospective CDR view (all CDR-delayed volume/ASR/carrier-split/hangup analytics moved to **Call Quality**). **CPS** = live seizures/sec; **connected calls** = FreeSWITCH `calls_active`; **dialogs** = Kamailio signaling concurrency; **Live ASR / failure %** = Kamailio INVITE reply-class rates over 5m. Carrier UP/DOWN is the only non-VM source — the SBCs' Kamailio-dispatcher OPTIONS probes via `carrier_trunk_health` (`voip-cdr-pg`), poller-fresh (~3–15s), not call-derived. `zone` label comes from `external_labels`; the **Zone** picker (`$zonere`) filters the SBC/dialog/ASR selectors. **Carriers:** Bandwidth Dallas (primary) · Bandwidth LA (secondary) · `local` = on-net. **Active SBC per zone** (top row) = the NLB election per zone, decided by per-SBC scrape LIVENESS (present_over_time of an always-exported Kamailio gauge, 2m window) — with failover-ratio=0 the primary serves whenever its Kamailio is alive, so: green = primary ACTIVE (normal, even at zero traffic) · orange = ⚠ ON STANDBY (primary dark, standby serving) · red = ZONE DARK (both dark). Election truth at all times — it does NOT depend on call volume; per-SBC volume lives in 'Dialogs per SBC — now' + 'CPS per SBC (1m rate)'.

panels.title: East — active SBC (HA election)
panels.description: NLB election truth for EAST (active/standby pair: poc-custom-voip = east-sbc-1 PRIMARY / kam-g2 = east-sbc-2 STANDBY), valid at ZERO traffic. With failover-ratio=0 the primary serves iff its Kamailio is alive — the /healthz fs_up component is common-mode (shared FreeSWITCH, fails BOTH SBCs together) so it never differentiates the pair — which makes per-SBC scrape liveness THE election signal: value = 1*(east-sbc-1 fresh) + 2*(east-sbc-1 stale AND east-sbc-2 fresh), freshness = present_over_time(kamailio_shmem_used_size{reporting_instance=...}[2m]) on an always-exported gauge. GREEN = primary serving (normal). ORANGE = FAILED OVER, standby serving (detection lag up to ~2m + refresh; the NLB itself flips in ~6s). RED 'ZONE DARK' = BOTH SBCs' metrics absent — zone outage OR metrics path down (vmagent/WAN/VictoriaMetrics): cross-check Infra Overview, the GCM 'SBC failover state' alert and gcloud backend-services get-health. Always shown regardless of the Zone filter. Runbook: docs/SBC_ACTIVE_STANDBY_RUNBOOK.md

targets.expr: 1 * (clamp_max(sum(present_over_time(kamailio_shmem_used_size{reporting_instance="east-sbc-1"}[2m])), 1) or vector(0)) + 2 * (clamp_max(sum(present_over_time(kamailio_shmem_used_size{reporting_instance="east-sbc-2"}[2m])), 1) or vector(0)) * (1 - (clamp_max(sum(present_over_time(kamailio_shmem_used_size{reporting_instance="east-sbc-1"}[2m])), 1) or vector(0)))

panels.title: West — active SBC (HA election)
panels.description: NLB election truth for WEST (active/standby pair: west-sbc-1 PRIMARY / west-sbc-2 STANDBY), valid at ZERO traffic. With failover-ratio=0 the primary serves iff its Kamailio is alive — the /healthz fs_up component is common-mode (shared FreeSWITCH, fails BOTH SBCs together) so it never differentiates the pair — which makes per-SBC scrape liveness THE election signal: value = 1*(west-sbc-1 fresh) + 2*(west-sbc-1 stale AND west-sbc-2 fresh), freshness = present_over_time(kamailio_shmem_used_size{reporting_instance=...}[2m]) on an always-exported gauge. GREEN = primary serving (normal). ORANGE = FAILED OVER, standby serving (detection lag up to ~2m + refresh; the NLB itself flips in ~6s). RED 'ZONE DARK' = BOTH SBCs' metrics absent — zone outage OR metrics path down (vmagent/WAN/VictoriaMetrics): cross-check Infra Overview, the GCM 'SBC failover state' alert and gcloud backend-services get-health. Always shown regardless of the Zone filter. Runbook: docs/SBC_ACTIVE_STANDBY_RUNBOOK.md

panels.title: Total CPS — now (1m)
panels.description: Fleet-wide calls per second right now: sum(rate(kamailio_trunk_cps[1m])) across all SBCs/zones. Rated capacity is ~500 CPS/zone; amber at 350, red at 500 on the all-zones view. Live from VictoriaMetrics (Kamailio mod_prometheus).

panels.title: Total connected calls — now
panels.description: Concurrent/active calls across the fleet at this instant — TRUE LIVE GAUGE from FreeSWITCH mod_prometheus (sum of freeswitch_calls_active over all media nodes), scraped every ~15s. Reflects calls actually up on the switches right now.

panels.title: Live ASR (5m)
panels.description: Live answer-seizure ratio from Kamailio INVITE reply classes over the last 5 minutes: 2xx / (2xx + 4xx + 5xx + 6xx). Honours the Zone filter. Green >= 50%, amber < 50%, red < 30%. This is the live signaling ASR, independent of CDR write lag.

panels.title: Live failure % (5m)
panels.description: Live INVITE failure fraction from Kamailio reply classes over 5m: (4xx + 5xx + 6xx) / (2xx + 4xx + 5xx + 6xx). Honours the Zone filter. Green < 10%, amber >= 10%, red >= 25%. Same denominator as Live ASR; the earliest live sign of a carrier/routing fault.

panels.title: On-net % — now
panels.description: Live share of active FreeSWITCH channels that are on-net (short-circuited internally, no carrier egress): sum(freeswitch_channels_active{on_net="true"}) / sum(freeswitch_channels_active{on_net=~"true|false"}). Higher = more carrier hairpin avoided (cost + quality win). Live gauge, all zones.

panels.title: Active dialogs — now
panels.description: Live signaling concurrency: sum(kamailio_dialog_active_dialogs) across the SBCs, honouring the Zone filter. This is SIP dialog state (what Kamailio is tracking) as opposed to media legs (freeswitch_calls_active) — the two should track closely; a divergence points at leaked dialogs or media/signaling mismatch.

panels.title: CPS over time — by zone (1m rate)
panels.description: Live calls-per-second per zone: sum by (zone)(rate(kamailio_trunk_cps[1m])), one line per zone. Watch load balance across East / West / Central. All zones shown regardless of the Zone filter.

panels.title: Concurrency over time — media vs signaling
panels.description: Live concurrency: media (FreeSWITCH calls_active) vs signaling (SBC dialog_active_dialogs), both fleet-wide. They should track closely; a persistent gap points at leaked dialogs or a media/signaling mismatch. All zones.

panels.title: CPS per FreeSWITCH (1m rate)
panels.description: Calls per second per media node = seizures per 1-minute bucket / 60, one series per freeswitch_node. Shows how call-start load is distributed across the FreeSWITCH fleet. Honours the Zone filter. Live from VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Calls per carrier trunk — inbound (live)
panels.description: Live inbound active calls per CARRIER trunk (Bandwidth PoP) from Kamailio's dialog profile: kamailio_trunk_active_calls{direction="inbound"}, summed by the bounded carrier `trunk` label, instant snapshot. Honours the Zone filter.

panels.title: Calls per carrier trunk — outbound (live)
panels.description: Live outbound active calls per CARRIER trunk (Bandwidth PoP) from Kamailio's dialog profile: kamailio_trunk_active_calls{direction="outbound"}, summed by the bounded carrier `trunk` label, instant snapshot. Honours the Zone filter.

panels.title: SIP INVITE reply-class rate (5m)
panels.description: Live Kamailio INVITE reply rate by response class over 5m: 2xx / 3xx / 4xx / 5xx / 6xx, sum(rate(kamailio_core_rcv_replies_Nxx_invite[5m])). Honours the Zone filter. A growing 4xx/5xx/6xx band is the earliest LIVE sign of a carrier/routing fault — this is the live replacement for the old CDR SIP-class panel.

panels.title: Live ASR trend (5m)
panels.description: The Live ASR stat as a trend line: 2xx / (2xx + 4xx + 5xx + 6xx) from Kamailio INVITE reply classes over 5m, honouring the Zone filter. Watch for a sustained dip below 50% (amber) / 30% (red).

panels.title: Carrier reachability — UP / DOWN
panels.description: Live Bandwidth carrier trunk reachability from the SBCs' Kamailio-dispatcher OPTIONS probes (carrier_trunk_health, keyed by duid). The ONLY panel on this wall not sourced from VictoriaMetrics — it reads voip-cdr-pg, but the health view is poller-fresh (~3-15s), NOT call-derived. 🟢 UP (reachable from >=1 SBC) · 🔴 DOWN (dead on every SBC) · 🟠 STALE (no fresh probe in 90s). Proactive — a dead carrier shows even at zero call volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Bandwidth Dallas (primary)' AS carrier, CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN last_updated IS NULL OR last_updated < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 2 WHEN status = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS carrier_up FROM carrier_trunk_health WHERE duid = 'bw-dallas-primary';

SELECT 'Bandwidth LA (secondary)' AS carrier, CASE WHEN status IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN last_updated IS NULL OR last_updated < now() - interval '90 seconds' THEN 2 WHEN status = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS carrier_up FROM carrier_trunk_health WHERE duid = 'bw-la-secondary';

panels.title: On-net vs off-net (live)
panels.description: Live split of active FreeSWITCH channels by on_net label: sum by (on_net)(freeswitch_channels_active). on-net = short-circuited internally (no carrier egress), off-net = hairpinned to a carrier. All zones.

panels.title: Inbound vs outbound (live)
panels.description: Live split of active FreeSWITCH channels by direction: sum by (direction)(freeswitch_channels_active{direction=~"inbound|outbound"}). All zones.

panels.title: SBC memory headroom (shmem used %)
panels.description: Live Kamailio shared-memory utilisation per SBC: kamailio_shmem_used_size / kamailio_shmem_total_size, one line per reporting_instance. Green < 70%, amber >= 70%, red >= 85%. Rising shmem is an early warning of a dialog/tm leak or an under-provisioned SBC before it starts dropping calls.

panels.title: Blocked IPs — now
panels.description: Live count of source IPs currently blocked by Kamailio's pike (flood-detection) module: sum(kamailio_pike_blocked_ips). Green at 0; any non-zero is an active flood/attack indicator worth eyeballing. Fleet-wide.

panels.title: Dialogs per SBC — now
panels.description: Live signaling concurrency broken out per SBC: sum by (reporting_instance)(kamailio_dialog_active_dialogs), honouring the Zone filter. Shows how dialog load is distributed across the SBC fleet — a lopsided SBC points at an NLB imbalance or a stuck peer.

panels.title: CPS per SBC (1m rate)
panels.description: Live calls-per-second processed by each SBC: sum by (reporting_instance)(rate(kamailio_trunk_cps{zone=~"$zonere"}[1m])), one line per SBC. With the active/standby NLB pairs a zone's whole load rides its ACTIVE SBC — steady state shows each zone's sbc-1 carrying everything and its sbc-2 flat at 0; the lines swap on failover/failback. This is the per-SBC processed-calls HISTORY that pairs with the election row up top (which answers 'who is active RIGHT NOW even at zero traffic'). Honours the Zone filter. Live from VictoriaMetrics.

list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.description: Filter by zone. On this live wall the picker maps to $zonere (the PromQL regex twin) and is applied as zone=~"$zonere" inside the SBC / dialog / ASR / SIP-class selectors. Fleet-wide trend panels (CPS-by-zone, concurrency, pies, memory) intentionally show every zone.
list.query: All : %, East : east, West : west, Central : central

list.name: zonere
list.label: Zone (regex)
list.description: Regex-valued twin of $zone for the PromQL (VictoriaMetrics) panels, used as zone=~"$zonere" inside metric selectors. Values map All->.* / East->east / West->west / Central->central, i.e. the same zone selections as $zone but expressed as a Prometheus regex instead of a SQL LIKE pattern (% is not a valid PromQL regex). Kept conceptually in sync with $zone; hidden from the dashboard bar. If you switch $zone, set this to the matching value (defaults to .* = all zones).
list.query: All : .*, East : east, West : west, Central : central
